reply.text: {"route": "answer", "say": "Getting ripped for summer comes down to two things: lifting hard enough to hold muscle and eating in a moderate deficit so the fat comes off. Most people do well on a push/pull/legs split or an upper/lower split, three to five days a week. Tell me how many days you can train, how long each session runs, and what gear you have, and I'll build the program. Summer is about seven months away, so there's plenty of time to do this properly."}
